app.title: Gambit Rogue
app.tagline: A chess roguelite on irregular boards

menu.demoNotice: A run is 5 levels in a row, with a reward after each win. Practice lets you replay each level with a fixed army.

levels.title: Practice

first-steps.name: First steps
first-steps.description: Two pawns and a bishop. Learn to move your pieces and attack.

the-bend.name: The bend
the-bend.description: An L-shaped board. Forests stop sliding pieces.

frozen-lake.name: Frozen lake
frozen-lake.description: Ice makes your pieces slide; water can only be jumped over.

hold-the-line.name: Hold the line
hold-the-line.description: An army is closing in. Keep your king alive for 6 rounds.

the-warden.name: The warden
the-warden.description: Take down the warden rook (5 HP) before the end of round 12.

levels.subtitle: Replay each level with a fixed army, as often as you like.

game.chooseTarget: Tap a highlighted square, or another piece.
game.chooseLanding: The target survives: choose where to land.
game.noMoves: None of your pieces can act.
game.demoComplete: You finished the demo. Well done!

reason.survived: You held out to the end.

ice.name: Ice
ice.rule: A piece that stops on it keeps sliding.

classes.title: Choose your hero
classes.subtitle: Your hero leads the army: if it falls, the run is lost.

sovereign.name: Sovereign
sovereign.description: A king surrounded by a large army. Whoever strikes him faces his riposte.

knightess.name: Knight-errant
knightess.description: A mobile, sturdy knight protected by her shield, backed by two bishops.

forester.name: Woodland stride
forester.description: Forests no longer stop its slides.

reach.name: Reach
reach.description: King: up to 2 squares. Pawn: one more square forward.

shield.name: Shield
shield.description: The first attack taken each level deals no damage.

riposte.name: Riposte
riposte.description: If it survives an attack and the attacker ends next to it, it strikes back at once.

promotion.name: Promotion
promotion.description: A pawn reaching the far edge becomes a queen for the rest of the run.

piercing.name: Piercing
piercing.description: Its slides pass through the first allied piece in the way.

run.deployHint: Tap one of your pieces to move it within the blue zone.
run.deployMove: Tap a zone square, or another of your pieces to swap them.
run.wonText: You made it through all {{total}} levels. Well done!
